CustomField.label: ModelName
CustomField.description: Written by: a human, in this record, deliberately. Read by: AAO_Extract, which sends it as the model id, and every Candidate row, which is stamped with it. Never hardcoded in Apex: a measurement that cannot name the model that produced it is not a measurement.
